💡 Key Engineering Design Decisions
1. TC Document = Executable Code (Single Source of Truth)
Gherkin .feature files serve as both TC documentation and executable code. Updating a TC automatically updates the automation — no dual maintenance needed.
# features/02-search/search.feature
Scenario: [TPS-042] Keyword Search Result Display
  Given Navigate to home screen
  When Enter "Solo Leveling" in the search box
  Then Search results page is shown
  And Search result list is visible
2. Resilient Tests — Survives UI Changes
Semantic-based locators replace XPath recording so tests survive UI changes. Assertions verify actual DOM element visibility — not just page load — preventing false passes.
// ✅ Semantic Locator + Meaningful Assertion
await page.getByRole('button', { name: /^log ?in$/i }).last().click();
await expect(page.locator('a[href*="/series/"]').first()).toBeVisible();

// ❌ XPath Recording + Weak Assertion
// await page.locator('//*[@id="app"]/div[2]/header/div/button[1]').click();
// await expect(page.locator('body')).toBeVisible();
3. Zero-Login TC Execution — CI Optimized
Login session is captured once and reused across all TCs. In CI, a base64-encoded session is injected via GitHub Secret — eliminating login overhead entirely.
// CI: Restore session from GitHub Secret
if (process.env.AUTH_STATE_B64) {
  const decoded = Buffer.from(process.env.AUTH_STATE_B64, 'base64').toString('utf-8');
  writeFileSync('.auth/user.json', decoded);
  return; // Skip login, start testing immediately
}
4. Tag-Based TC Filtering per Environment
Tags @skip · @qa · @pcwonly automatically filter which TCs run in PROD / QA / CBT. One tag controls the execution scope — no code changes required.
// PROD: exclude TCs tagged @skip and @qa
tags: 'not @skip and not @qa'

// QA Environment: @skipexcluded only, @qa included
tags: 'not @skip'

// MWeb: additionally exclude PC Web-only (@pcwonly) TCs
tags: 'not @pcwonly and not @skip and not @qa'
5. Auto Evidence Collection on Failure — Faster Debugging
Trace, screenshot, and video are captured only on test failure — zero storage waste on passing runs. Failed test artifacts are immediately available for root-cause analysis.
// playwright.config.ts
use: {
  trace:      'retain-on-failure',  // retain trace for failed TCs only
  screenshot: 'only-on-failure',   // capture screenshot at failure moment
  video:      'retain-on-failure',  // retain video for failed TCs only
}
